output.reason: The upgrade guide says the wildcard view permission was removed from the Kyverno controllers and replaced by a role binding to the default `view` role [ev-01e97dc9c4df]. The renders confirm that the */*:get, */*:list and */*:watch rules were dropped from the admission-controller, background-controller and reports-controller core ClusterRoles [ev-6af5be55b5f4][ev-0ae726bec846][ev-fbb2a078179b]. Without a group, name=* also matches kyverno.io/* rules that are still in the 1.13.0 render, so the validator refuted it [ev-686e3f03e42c][ev-575e1935f511]; the subject needs group "*". The replacedBy "*/view" is not an rbac-permission the evidence shows. The replacement is a binding to the `view` role, so replacedBy is dropped.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the wildcard view permission (group *, resource *: get/list/watch) from the controllers' core ClusterRoles and adds a role binding to the default `view` role instead.
